cell_type.evidence: Multi-epitope affinity purification mass spectrometry (meAP-MS) analysis of TMEM9-, TMEM9B- and CLC3- associated proteins from solubilized mouse brain membranes identified chloride channel subtypes CLCN3, 4 and 5 as exclusive interaction partners of TMEM9 and TMM9B.

disease_state.evidence: inferred: The gross morphology of double KO E12.5 embryos was normal.

material_type.evidence: Mouse brains from different genotypes (WT, transgenic Venus-ClC-3, T9A−/−, and T9B−/−) were collected and snap-frozen.

sample_source.evidence: Plasma membrane-enriched fractions were prepared from two freshly isolated mouse brains, solubilized and processed following the complexome-profiling procedure.

strain.evidence: Tmem9 and Tmem9b cDNAs were cloned by RT-PCR from total RNA isolated from C57BL/6 N mouse kidney using TRIZOL (Invitrogen) and RNeasy columns (Qiagen).
